title: Vertical loop lab
caption: Release height against loop radius. Below 2.5R the cart peels off.
draw: var g=9.8,R=p.R,h=p.h;var v0sq=2*g*h,tt=t%5.0,dt=0.003,phi=0,vsq=v0sq,lost=-1,n=Math.floor(tt/dt),i;for(i=0;i<n;i++){vsq=v0sq-2*g*R*(1-Math.cos(phi));if(vsq<=0){vsq=0;lost=phi;break;}if(vsq/R+g*Math.cos(phi)<0){lost=phi;break;}phi=phi+Math.sqrt(vsq)/R*dt;if(phi>2*Math.PI){phi=phi-2*Math.PI;}}var span=Math.max(h,2*R)+0.8;var sc=Math.min((H-46)/span,(W-70)/12);var gy=H-18,cx=W*0.64,cy=gy-R*sc;ctx.font='12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,gy-h*sc);ctx.lineTo(W*0.30,gy);ctx.lineTo(W-16,gy);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*sc,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle=C.faint;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.setLineDash([3,4]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,gy-h*sc);ctx.lineTo(W-16,gy-h*sc);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,gy-2.5*R*sc);ctx.lineTo(W-16,gy-2.5*R*sc);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('release h = '+h.toFixed(1)+' m',22,gy-h*sc-5);ctx.fillText('2.5R = '+(2.5*R).toFixed(2)+' m',W-110,gy-2.5*R*sc-5);ctx.fillText('R = '+R.toFixed(2)+' m',cx+4,cy-2);ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx,cy-R*sc);ctx.stroke();var px=cx+R*sc*Math.sin(phi),py=gy-R*sc*(1-Math.cos(phi));ctx.fillStyle=(lost>=0?C.faint:C.figure);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();if(lost>=0){ctx.fillStyle=C.accent;ctx.fillText('loses contact here',px+9,py-4);}var vtopsq=v0sq-4*g*R,vtop=(vtopsq>0?Math.sqrt(vtopsq):0),need=Math.sqrt(g*R);ctx.fillStyle=C.accent;ctx.fillText('top: needs v = sqrt(gR) = '+need.toFixed(2)+' m/s',cx-R*sc,cy-R*sc-8);out.note='v at top = '+vtop.toFixed(2)+' m/s, needs '+need.toFixed(2)+' m/s  ->  '+(h>=2.5*R?'completes the loop':'falls off the track')+'   (h = '+h.toFixed(1)+' m, 2.5R = '+(2.5*R).toFixed(2)+' m)';
